PART III - LANDS Title Registration AMENDMENT REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, NO. 21 OF 1998 (Section 14) In regard to the title to parcel of land No. 109 of Block 08 contained in the Cadastral Map No. 520011 situated in the village of Habara-kada within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 481 B - Habarakada South in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Homagama in the District of Colombo in the Province of Western published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1681/50 of 26th November 2010. “109” mentioned in the column of “Parcel No.” of the schedule is amended as “ 224” and “to access parcel Nos. 105, 107, 111, 198 and 188” mentioned in the column of the schedule is amended as “to access parcel Nos. 225 and 226” G.VIJITHA NANDA KUMAR, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura” Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla 28th September, 2015. 11 - 714
